_how_to_edit: Projects on the market that are not (yet) in DLD records: EOI / pre-launch. They show in the project search with their developer; picking one ticks EOI and fills the developer for the buyer to confirm. dev = what we type in the developer box (brand name is fine, e.g. Nakheel). st: 'teaser' for a project only rumoured / teased by the developer (shown as 📣 Teaser). tags: extra search words (e.g. dso). Daily task adds new launches/teasers not yet in DLD records; each has 'added' (date) and 'src' (where it was announced). Remove an entry once it appears in DLD records (projects.json).
